notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands.
description:
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping two mana-producing lands.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Ley Weaver.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
